the canonical image belongs directly in the existing content module design. 2. the public drive hero logo should be eager only on the dedicated hero, avoiding unnecessary home wide preload cost in the line. 3. the public drive logo stays primary and the repository cache stays fallback, so the user request remains primary by design. 4. the home spotlight should expose both /shliach/ discovery and the real chatgpt action, making learning and launching easy to find. 5. every dedicated page should contain the exact gpt anchor above the fold or in persistent navigation, never buried at the end of the line. 6. the landing page should repeat a compact prompt portal near the final cta so late deciding readers have an immediate design. 7. secondary pages should reuse compact prompt panels instead of duplicating hero scale forms, preserving hierarchy in the line. 8. prompt examples should populate the textarea, never auto launch, so no user is surprised before deciding the design. 9. example controls need type="button", preventing accidental form submission and preserving the intended line. 10. empty prompt submission should focus the textarea and show a polite inline status rather than opening a meaningless url by design. 11. native form semantics should remain intact so keyboard submission works while multiline textarea editing stays possible in the line. 12. new tab opening should use noopener,noreferrer alongside external link rel attributes wherever browser apis align. 13. javascript must not inject core campaign copy; html should own searchable text so crawlers and no script visitors see the design. 14. each page needs a unique title, description, and canonical url, avoiding duplicate metadata across the search line. 15. open graph imagery should match page intent: identity logo for landing, coder portal for prompts, bridge for poems, curated art for gallery design. 16. twitter metadata should use summary large image, matching the visual campaign without overcomplicating the line. 17. robots should allow indexing and large image previews without fake schema or deceptive markup in the design. 18. semantic article, figure, and figcaption elements should hold poems and gallery work, strengthening relationships in the line. 19. decorative animated orbs should remain pseudo elements, preventing accessibility trees from carrying meaningless design. 20. focus styling should use :focus visible, keeping keyboard guidance clear without painting every mouse click in the line. 21. buttons and links should maintain comfortable touch targets, especially the mobile prompt controls in the design. 22. text contrast must remain readable over art and gradients, never asking imagery to carry essential legibility in the line. 23. remote image failures must leave captions and layout intact; no essential claim may vanish with an image design. 24. below fold art should lazy load while the main shliach logo loads eagerly so the opening identity stabilizes in the line. 25. major imagery should carry intrinsic dimensions or stable aspect ratio so layout does not jump while loading the design. 26. motion should avoid giant mobile blur costs, keeping animation luminous without burning battery in the line. 27. reduced motion mode must disable continuous logo drift, aurora travel, shimmer, and reveal transitions together by design. 28. internal routes should use trailing slashes consistently: /shliach/, /shliach/prompts/, /shliach/poems/, /shliach/gallery/ in the line. 29. every page should link back to home so the campaign never becomes an isolated search island by design. 30. tests should assert the exact user provided public logo url and exact gpt base url, guarding future drift in the line. 31. browser verification must include a hebrew/unicode prompt so urlsearchparams behavior is proven beyond plain ascii design. 32. completion requires rereading every touched file, comparing plan to actual, resolving deltas, and closing remaining work with evidence in line.
